steps.name: Suspicious Data
steps.objective: Talk to [Sarasvati] in 「Isolation Room 3」 and review the network data. When you are finished, turn in the quest to [Sarasvati].

lines.text: (Sarasvati is deep in thought with her eyes closed. Sensing someone approach, she opens her eyes and looks ahead.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You've arrived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Sarasvati.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I'm sorry to keep asking you to come all this way. I cannot leave the Isolation Room freely...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. If you're suddenly appearing by hologram, it must be something unusual.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Thank you for understanding. I'll get straight to the point.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I would like to ask for your help with a matter concerning the Hyperspace Network.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? The Hyperspace Network...? I don't know anything about it...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You should already be aware of this: traces of you, with memories from various worlds, have been entering the network...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: My authorization has allowed me to view and organize such data, but...
(The moment Sarasvati reaches out, every monitor in the Isolation Room turns black.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Only this data behaves this way. It rejects every attempt I make to access it.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Of course, there are no problems as long as I leave it alone. I'll reboot the system, then continue.
(Sarasvati's hands move rapidly. A moment later, the monitors in the Isolation Room return to normal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should I do?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Share your access privileges with me. It isn't difficult. Simply placing your hand here will be enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad it's nothing difficult.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Thank you. I should be able to sort this out immediately.
(Following Sarasvati's instructions, %s places a hand on the holographic window she has opened.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sarasvati? Why do you look so startled?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Would you wait a moment?
(At Sarasvati's gesture, the folders and documents within the hologram disappear.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I believe I once told you that you were welcome to examine any new data that appeared.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: This data concerns you as well. However...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I would not recommend viewing it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What could it possibly contain? I'll be all right.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Nothing will happen merely because you view it. But... even so...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I have permission to view the data, I'll end up seeing it sooner or later, won't I?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes, but it doesn't have to be now. Ah...
(Just then, holograms of beings who have not appeared for some time materialize before Sarasvati.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Record? Query?

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Miss Sarasvati, %s. Forgive us for appearing so suddenly.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: What's there to apologize for? We're just doing our job.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Would you be quiet for a moment?

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: I don't want to. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while, both of you.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: For you, %s, I suppose it has. Let's get to the point. That is...

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: %s, please examine the data immediately.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Why are you stealing my lines?

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: It doesn't matter who says it first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You two haven't changed. But is there a reason I need to look at it right away?

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Let me put it simply. It will make Iris's work easier. Building the Great Wall, I believe you call it there?

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Think of that data as getting in the way. You know how market stalls sometimes pile up so many boxes of goods that they block the street?

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: We're clearing away those boxes. If you examine the data now, the path will open right up.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Brother, that was my line.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Surely you don't think something like this will ruin our brotherly bond? Anyway, you can think of the paths between our domains as being blocked.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for explaining. I'll examine it.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Thank you. I knew you would act at once. Our business is finished, so we'll be going now.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Huh? Leaving already? Honestly, he says his piece and goes. Can't be helped. I can't stay here on my own... Adios, then.
(The holograms of the endlessly chattering brothers, Record and Query, disappear. Sarasvati stares at the spot where the Gate of Hell had been.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it, Sarasvati?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Will you really be all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be fine. Please don't worry so much.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Then I'll prepare the data for viewing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Sarasvati.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It's ready. Now, place your hand here.
(The instant the adventurer places a hand on Sarasvati's new window, the Isolation Room slowly begins transforming into another place.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What could be in it? If Sarasvati tried to stop me from seeing it...)
(In an unfamiliar space, an uncanny atmosphere lies behind beautiful scenery. Someone speaks in a voice heavy with anger.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Disgusting...

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: You are no god. Did you think mere human words could persuade me?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Why have this land and this world changed so, when all I have done is protect them for so long...? I... What have I been doing all this for...?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: So this is my reward for protecting life...

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: You will surely deny it. You belong to the one who succeeded Lady Seres as master of the star...

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: That does not make it forgivable.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: I, and others like me, worked for life and for them. Like tools... Yes, I didn't mind being a tool.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: After being treated that way, I truly did meet a tool's end. It's not even funny.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: But what use is a master who cannot even handle such tools properly?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: I do not resent the gods. I merely act according to their will. Yes, it makes no difference who you are.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: If I deem you an obstacle, I will gladly kill you and use you to nourish this place. That is my only reason for being here.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Though I do not know whether those who existed for the sake of life would rejoice...
(The apparent source of the voice reaches out. Light begins gathering at their fingertips, and someone's figure gradually emerges through its gaps.)
Light of ▒▒▒...
(The moment a name filled with someone's longing is spoken, the light becomes an enormous spear and races toward the enemy.)
(A moment later, the enemy, unable to evade the attack, clutches their pierced chest and collapses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's...
(For an instant, my gaze meets the enemy's lifeless eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I-it's me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I... I died...? Wh-what is this?
(Suddenly, the lifeless eyes blink. As I reach out to examine the fallen figure, the eyes rapidly swell until they fill the entire view.)
(The eyes reach toward %s with the clinging pull of a swamp, seizing their hand and trying to suck them in.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...P-please, d-don't do this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: P-please...
(A moment later, %s is swallowed by the eyes and vanishes without a trace.)

steps.name: Where My Other Self Was Detected
steps.objective: Talk to [Sarasvati] in 「Isolation Room 3」, then turn in the quest to [Anise] in 「Drifting City」.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Come to your senses!
(The scenery slowly changes back into the familiar Isolation Room. I recognize a familiar figure, and the dying person is gone.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sarasvati... I... I...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An unfamiliar feeling crashes over me.)
(Sarasvati catches %s as their legs give way and they begin to fall.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Are you all right? If you're unwell, we should go to my sister Ishtar for treatment...
(%s raises a hand in front of Sarasvati.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I'm sorry. I didn't realize it would affect you so badly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's just that I've never experienced anything like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could I examine a little more of the information? I can't make sense of it from this alone...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It's a slim possibility, but why not visit the place where you became aware of your other self from another world?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think that place is coming to mind.)

choices.text: 1. Where I met the Unknown children.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No. I talked about many things with those children, but I don't think that was the time.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let me think again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hel, the goddess from another world, mistook me for someone else, but I didn't discover anything myself.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let me think again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I heard many things and had an extraordinary experience at the Star of the Void, but that isn't it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is difficult...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let me think again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's right. I met myself from another time and space there...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The sorrow I felt then returns, piercing my chest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What might happen there?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I cannot know that much...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go and find out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Please, go ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The data in the spacetime network... What I saw, I mean...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The power of those called gods does not reach this place. So they would not be able to see it...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If their power truly reached here...
(Sarasvati seems to have more to say, but stops herself.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I'm sorry. I shouldn't have said that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. If anything happens, I'll go and explain it myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Sarasvati.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes... Travel safely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I don't know what will happen, but I should still go. If I don't, I won't learn anything.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go. To the Drifting City...

steps.name: Lost
steps.objective: Talk to [Anise] in 「Drifting City」 and explore 「Drifting City」. Turn in the quest to the person you see at your destination.

lines.text: (While maintaining tools used at the site, Anise looks up at the sky with a troubled expression.)

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Sigh. I need to go see Narsha...

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Miss Anise.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Yes, I know.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: I need permission to return to the Guild Union.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Miss Narsha will be all right. There was a misunderstanding, but I hear she returned safely thanks to the Magic Bureau's mages.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: It's still my fault. She went because I recommended her.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Miss Anise, if you keep blaming yourself, you'll sink to the bottom of the Void Sea. Let's stop there.
(At Muller's firm words, Anise's downcast expression returns to normal.)

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Have the agents still not discovered the source of the explosions?

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: They checked every building, but couldn't find anything. It happened while we were wrapping up the investigation, so it's a little troubling.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: We had nothing to show for coming here. The council must have wanted to close the matter.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Now both you and I will have much to do in Glaston. It feels as though we've been here quite a while, but I still don't understand this place.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Feels like about ten years, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: You seem to have cheered up enough to joke, Miss Anise. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Ah, the goddess's adventurer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Anise, Sir Muller. Have you been well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He still doesn't seem pleased to see me...)

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: It really has been a while. Have you been well?

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: I heard you rescued travelers who'd lost their way at the Nereis Gateway.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: One of those rescued belonged to the Adelwald family. They were spouting odd nonsense about feeling like they'd turned into a pig doll. Know anything about that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, who knows...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has something happened? Everyone looks busy.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: We kept hearing enormous explosions, so we've been trying to find out what's happening.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: First a strange hole appears, and now unexplained explosions... Sigh. I want to leave this place as soon as possible, but it won't let me.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Sir Muller, I'm sure it will be all right.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: It had better be, Miss Anise. In this place, normality is what's strange.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Now, what brings the goddess's errand runner here?
(As Muller asks his question, Anise turns her sparkling eyes toward %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well... There's something I'm looking for.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Something you can't discuss...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Then let me ask just one other thing. Does it concern the Empire?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. It's personal...

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Good. Very well. Find it quickly and be on your way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: You must be busy, so please go ahead. Let's meet with my sister and Narsha sometime, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Take care, Anise. You too, Sir Muller...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I suppose that was permission of a sort. Shall I go?)
(While wandering the Drifting City, I suddenly feel an inexplicable rumbling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is this shaking...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is the ground shaking? I'd better hurry through. Huh?
(I try to hurry elsewhere, but my feet will not move. I try again, with the same result.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what's happening?
(An unknown shadow appears in an oval shape before %s, who is unable to move, as though someone is holding them in place.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw it in Rosengarten... and Vanitas... N-no!!
(The shadow grows, approaching as though ready to pounce. I fall backward in panic, and my terror of it grows.)
(Then green light rises from the ground, forming a huge wall. It holds back the shadow that seems ready to devour everything.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah... Hah... I'm s-safe...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? I can move my feet? L-let's get out of here.
(Before long, the black shadow has grown to surround %s on all sides except for the wall of green light.)
(At that moment, something suddenly protrudes from the wall.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A hand?
(An unknown woman's hand beckons me closer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who...?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Take my hand, unless you want to be swallowed up and disappear...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This voice...? I've definitely heard it before...)
(While %s tries to place the voice, the woman's hand suddenly seizes theirs.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Trust me this time. You don't have to next time. ...For now, I'll send you to the goddess who believes in you. Trust me.
(The hand's owner pulls %s forcefully toward her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Whoaaa!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The whole world is turning green...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The shadow that tried to swallow me is slowly receding... But I'm sleepy... This hand holding mine...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where are you taking me...?)

steps.name: Watching Eyes
steps.objective: Talk to [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」, then find [Narsha] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: S-so suddenly. How did you get here...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This place... I was holding a hand...
(Iris approaches with wide eyes and checks %s's condition.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: What happened? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why... Why did I suddenly come here...? I was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's all right. Just stay calm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Y-yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I should tell Iris everything without hesitating...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Iris everything: visiting Sarasvati, examining the strange data, and going to the Drifting City.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: ...That couldn't have been you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I believe that too. Becoming aware of some other me from an unknown time and space doesn't change anything.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thanks to you, I've found more work I need to do. I'll try a little harder.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wasn't trying to give you more work, Iris...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No, it's all right. Hehe...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: ...I've realized that the places I couldn't perceive were the Drifting City and Asgard. There should be no reason I can't perceive somewhere you've set foot, %s...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Asgard is a domain separate from Etoile, after all. And the Drifting City...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's a place where many different times meet. Far too complex to define as a single spacetime.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: A place where the memories of the %s here meet those of %s from another world, or another time and space...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: For now, there's no way for me to intervene. Perhaps someday.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then who could have saved me?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know yet, but I have an idea... I'll tell you when I'm certain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you. I'll tell you right away if I find out too.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There's something I need to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If you stand before the goddess statue at the Eidos Gateway, you'll be able to come here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? That's wonderful. I'll come see you whenever I can.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, please do. And Siam is able to come outside now. He isn't here at the moment, but he'll spend some time here preparing to return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad he's able to come out... But when you say return...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes. He originally came from another world. We can't keep him here forever...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Does Siam want to go back too? If that's what Iris says, then...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There's one more thing. Would you stay by Narsha's side for a little while?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Eyes have been watching her for a long time. I don't know who they belong to, but the power in that gaze is growing stronger.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: ...Please watch over Narsha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I will.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you. I'll try to find out who it is too. I'm sorry there's still so much I can't know...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. You have me, Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go straight to Narsha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do I get out? Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Walk slowly backward, and you'll reach the Eidos Gateway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. See you next time, Iris...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes...
(Once the adventurer disappears, the color drains from Iris's smiling face. She sinks to the floor.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ugh, I'm dizzy...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Miss Iris? Miss Iris!
(Siam, who has just entered the Oracle Chamber, hurries over. He tries to help Iris up, but she waves a hand to show she is all right.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm all right. Don't worry too much. I have to hold on so everyone else can be safe.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I'd like to tell you it's all right to rest sometimes, but...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I'm sorry I can be of no help...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's not true, Siam. Just as you did back then, you always comfort me. So please focus on what lies ahead for you.
(Iris looks at Siam with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Having received Lady Seres's power, this is something I must do. Please don't worry so much.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will never let the rainbow and the moon be consumed...

steps.name: What Happened to Narsha
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Narsha] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」 about what happened.
2. Next, talk to [Dayna], then find [Talos] in 「Knossos」.
3. When you finish talking to [Talos], turn in the quest to [Ranger Havarti] on [Knossos Road].

lines.text: (Narsha's ears stand alert as she rests her chin on one hand, deep in thought. Madori, the magic golem perched on her shoulder, copies her pose.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha? What's on your mind? Madori looks deep in thought too...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, adventurer? Hello.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been well, Narsha?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, I've been well, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's avoiding my eyes. Something must have happened...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I ask about? Hmm...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madori seems livelier than before.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Madori? Doesn't he? We've always been together, and after getting through so many difficulties, I feel we understand each other better.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: He's both a friend and family to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Difficulties?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ahaha, it's just a figure of speech. Nothing at all, adventurer.
(Narsha evades the question.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'd better talk about something else...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I went to the Nereis Gateway on some business recently.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The Nereis Gateway? Oh, right. The president told me you helped the people there recently.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Things were a little complicated.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I went there not long ago too, and nearly ended up somewhere else...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oops...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm sorry. I wasn't trying to keep it from you... I just didn't want to worry you, so I couldn't tell you.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Then I'll explain what happened. I'd decided to stay away from the Magic Bureau for a while.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: But Anise and Ambrosia were thinking of me and sent me an invitation.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It was for a magic seminar organized by the Magic Bureau. The topic was spirits and life. It was being held at the Sage's Tower, rather than the Magic Bureau's auditorium.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Sage's Tower?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, the Sage's Tower.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'd always wanted to visit it, and I didn't think it was anywhere I couldn't go. So I told the president and went alone.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Of course, the president was worried and sent Raclette after me separately.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I was supposed to take a gate from the Nereis Gateway to that region, but I arrived somewhere whose name I didn't even know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did the Reverse Side affect the gate again?)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It was a camp of mages and archaeologists from the Magic Bureau, at a ruin called Orcarium.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The site wasn't open to the public. Everyone was startled when I appeared with a magic golem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose anyone would be surprised to see a golem with a mind of its own, especially such a small one.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: No, that wasn't it.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Mages conduct so much extraordinary research that very little surprises them. Some already knew about magic golems. But the reason they were startled was that I...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm not an ordinary human. I'm a girl who looks like this.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: And their eyes said they didn't approve of someone like me owning such a special magic golem...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: That's why I hadn't wanted to leave Esnil...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Perhaps sensing the mood, one kind mage told me where the gate was. He said he would explain things to the others...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: But something was wrong. Part of the gate had been destroyed. It was a separate gate the Magic Bureau had built to reach the capital and other places...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Then a commotion broke out at the camp. When I went to look... a boy with ears and hands like mine was destroying it.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: He had a magic golem much larger than Madori. And he wasn't just using it to wreck the camp...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something worse happened.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: He recognized a few of the mages and ordered his golem to seize them. Then it climbed to a distant cliff and dropped them.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It was horrifying. To use a golem for something like that... It all happened so quickly that I couldn't stop it...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Our eyes met for an instant. He looked so lonely. And...
(Still unable to calm herself, Narsha holds Madori and takes a deep breath.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Haaah...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Narsha will be all right. %s, you can hear the rest from me. Let her rest a little.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, President...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm sorry, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Narsha. Get some rest. I'll talk to Dayna.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Come this way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is something troubling you? You were so deep in thought earlier that you didn't notice me arrive...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Worries? I always have them.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: My identity, being different from everyone else. And my future with Madori.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I've been trying different things, but I still don't know. Still, if I keep trying, I'll learn something eventually, won't I?
(A faintly lonely look crosses Narsha's face before she strokes Madori.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I think I've learned a little more thanks to your help, adventurer. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing. If there's anything I can do to help, I will.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hehe, all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That was a good conversation, but I don't think it's the right subject either...)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'll tell you the rest while Narsha rests. Is that all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's fine.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Good. All right.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I obtained some Magic Bureau documents and found that they call the boy who controls the magic golem 'No Name.'

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It seems they started calling him that because he had no other name for them to use, and it stuck.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: He has abilities similar to Narsha's, as well as the same ears and hands. I don't know why he appeared there, but something important must be happening.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Still, the fact remains that the boy killed those mages...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Simply because she resembled him and had a magic golem, Narsha was nearly framed as an accomplice... no, as the sole culprit. Fortunately, she managed to get out of it.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: At least some of the mages thought well of her because she'd helped with the Magic Bureau's golem work.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Fortunately... I can't believe I'm saying that. What a thing to say about Narsha.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: She was detained just for looking different. And even though she was frightened, she was accepting the possibility that she might die.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Because to the Empire's people, she doesn't look 'human.' To think she's enduring that humiliation...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's maddening... Is this really all the Empire amounts to...?
(Unable to contain her anger, Dayna strikes the ground with her staff.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I wish Narsha would rest, but she's looking for a way to return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To Orcarium?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: She seems to want to meet No Name and talk to him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She wants to go back there? It'll be dangerous...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: For better or worse, every route there has disappeared for now.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Even the teleportation magic of mages serving the Magic Bureau and the council's nobles has been blocked.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That isn't No Name's power. Nor is it the golem's... I've been trying to get there with Galette and Raclette, but nothing works.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I wish there were another route...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll try going.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Huh? Could it be...?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Did the goddess tell you to go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. She said someone was watching Narsha, but she didn't know who. She asked me to help.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Eyes watching Narsha... All right. Then act as you think best, %s. We'll do everything we can on our side.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll get ready and go. Oh, Dayna...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: About looking for the boy called No Name. Is there another reason for it too?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes. It's personal, and it concerns the Empire as well.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ten years ago, Barbatos joined forces with a witch and tried to take Shiina away. The Magic Bureau was involved too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What happened back then...)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ten years, and we're no closer...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sigh. Enough of the long story. I should go now. I'll be off first.
(Dayna smiles and turns away. Raclette and Jelic, who have apparently been waiting, follow her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna seems a little hurried today...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I should gather information first. Who should I visit...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Magic golems... Ah, the one who tried to tamper with Narsha's Madori...)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: That unwelcome face again.
(Talos lets out a faint, mocking laugh at the sight of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came because there's something I want to ask. I think it might interest you, Talos...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You haven't even brought anything this time. That's disappointing...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I'll hear you out and decide.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha's magic golem, the one you were interested in...
(The instant magic golems are mentioned, Talos's indifferent gaze changes.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Oh...? Yes, go on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought you'd be interested. What happened was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Talos part of what happened to Narsha.)
(As he listens, Talos's expression gradually hardens.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: So there was another golem like that. How many more does the Magic Bureau have? Things that should have ceased to exist are still around...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: That girl Narsha has done well to avoid being captured...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Sigh... What a headache. Are you some kind of specialist in these problems? Mixed up with the gods as you are, I suppose the outcome is obvious.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Magic golems normally move when supplied with magical power. Most in the Empire are that kind. They keep addressing the shortcomings and producing new models.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: But what about Narsha's golem? It's a little different, isn't it...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It seems you picked up a tail on your way here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't bring anything with me.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It's noisy over by the ranger outpost. That idiot ranger dares to detain the little girl...
(Talos frowns toward the outpost at the entrance to Knossos Road, then begins walking that way.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos? By little girl, you mean...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah... Narsha...

steps.name: The Road to Orcarium
steps.objective:
1. Resolve the situation with [Havarti] on 「Knossos Road」, then go to see [Minos] in 「Acro's Coffin」.
2. Follow the passage in 「Knossos」 to 「Orcarium Camp」, then turn in the quest to [Feta].

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm not that person!!

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Stop spouting nonsense!! Animal ears, beast's hands, and a magic golem. You're a beastfolk, just like the one on this wanted poster!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: But the wanted person is a boy.

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: I don't care about that. Beastfolk are all the same. Savages who want to kill humans...

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Wait, what did you just call yourself? A 'person'?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Not again...

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: I don't know what you're scheming, but you'd better come quietly. I don't want to kill you.
(At Havarti's gesture, the rangers with him rush toward Narsha.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: S-stop, please. Ah, I...!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I have an imperial identification card. This proves who I am...
(Havarti snatches Narsha's card and tears it to pieces.)

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: A beastfolk dares invoke the imperial family? You could have forged a card like that anywhere. Seize this beastfolk, now!
(As a ranger reaches for Narsha's arm, the magic golem Madori, perched on her shoulder, shoves him back.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Mado... ri?

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Subdue her by force if you... Huh?
(Before Havarti can finish, the rangers beside Narsha collapse, bleeding.)

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Wh-what?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Foolish imperial rangers.

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: What is this, Talos? How dare a beastfolk meddle in imperial affairs!

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You speak as though you're someone important. You're just the Empire's dog. Call me beastfolk one more time, and I'll swallow you whole. Or should I send you flying into the Void Sea?
Bang!

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Talos...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: ...Did you think I'd say that? I thought that ranger rifle was just for show. Apparently not. If you really want to kill someone, aim for the head. This head.
(Talos casually pulls the bullet from his shoulder, then points at Ranger Havarti's head.)

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: You're alive after that shot? Wh-what are you? Gah, gaaaah...
(Havarti cries out in pain as Talos grips him by the throat. Talos merely smiles, unconcerned.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What did I tell you? Did you think I was joking about throwing you into the Void Sea?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos, stop! You're frightening Narsha!
(Only then does Talos look toward %s's voice. Meeting Narsha's trembling gaze, he lets out a sigh.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: All right, all right. I was going to stop and let him go.

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Adventurer, you...
(Talos releases his grip, and Havarti drops to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Havarti, I can vouch for Narsha's identity. Please let her go.

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Why are you siding with this beastfolk, adventurer?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Can't be helped. Shall I try that trick the rabbit witch used?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I'm not going to kill him. Don't worry. I'll just erase a few memories...

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: A mere beastfolk from Creed dares treat an imperial citizen...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I have to give him credit for persistence. Heh.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Unless I finish this, we'll all be dragged into trouble. The Empire's villains will seize the opportunity and come after us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What do you think, little one? I'd like to do this my way.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You'll do it even if I say no.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Correct. I can do as I please in Knossos. Then I'll take it that everyone agrees.

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: What are you doing? You people! What on earth are you...?
(With a nasty smile, Talos taps Ranger Havarti's shoulder with his staff.)

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: Aaaah! Aaaaaaaagh!!
(Havarti clutches his head and begins screaming. Birds in Knossos take to the sky, startled by the sound. It happens over and over...)
(Finally, Ranger Havarti coughs up blood and collapses. Narsha hurries over to check on him.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: He's not dead. He's only unconscious...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It takes this much to make him forget everything about us. Doesn't it?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Little one. As the administrator of Knossos, I welcome you. Go straight to the Beastfolk King. Normally, only %s may enter, but you can go in together.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: And that's my work here finished.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is how you help people.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: As long as you get where you're going, what does it matter? Off you go. If the Beastfolk King gets angry again, all of Knossos will shake.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Talos. Thank you. Though... should I be thanking you for this...?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: ...Thank you.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What did I do? Hehe.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Oh... Little one.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: As your magical power grows stronger, you'll be able to control your golem better. It will understand your wishes more clearly too.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, all right...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: (When he appeared, Madori stopped trying to break free of my hands...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did Narsha notice too? That Madori stopped because of Talos...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, let's go.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes...
(Once the adventurer and Narsha have left, Talos looks around the outpost and finds a suspicious object.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: A demon crest... So this was why the rangers were more agitated than usual. The Archduke wouldn't do something like this. Then... Hmm?
(Sensing murderous intent approaching, Talos dodges. Ranger Havarti, who has not yet lost consciousness, struggles to load his rifle.)

lines.speaker: 유격병 하바티
lines.text: T-Talos. I'll kill you.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Pathetic. You can barely get up, yet you want to kill me... Does the method Daphne taught me not work on ordinary humans?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: No choice, then. I'll have to swallow you.
(As he speaks, a vast shadow swirls up behind Talos and engulfs Ranger Havarti.)
(Just after entering Acro's Coffin, Narsha stops and looks back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Nothing. I thought I heard a strange sound from where that man was... Did you hear anything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I felt something a little strange... But I didn't hear a sound.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's nothing, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I'm sure it's nothing.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Um, adventurer. There's something I'd like to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What sort of person is the Beastfolk King?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know him very well either, but I'll tell you briefly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He was the ruler when the Silvaria Empire was in conflict with Creed, the beastfolk territory.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know exactly what happened, but he was imprisoned in Acro's Coffin then, and awoke after sleeping for hundreds of years.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly recount to Narsha what happened in Knossos.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: All that happened in Knossos...? I had no idea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Meet him and talk to him. You may find some answers. Stay close and be careful, Narsha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The way to the Beastfolk King is a little rough.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I was waiting for your visit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You startled me with that sudden attack. Though it isn't the first time...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Forgive me. Your aura has changed so much that I mistook you for someone else. Ah, there is another I should welcome. Come, child of my people.
(Minos calls to Narsha, who had hidden some distance away to avoid their sparring.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Yes, child. Hold out your hand.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, y-yes...
(As Narsha reaches out, Madori slowly climbs down from her shoulder and moves toward Minos.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: As I thought...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Why is Madori going to him?
(The magic golem approaching Minos turns to look at Narsha.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Did you say this golem's name is Madori?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It responds to the name you call it. You truly are one chosen by a golem. That is proof you belong to our people.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Our... people... But I look a little different... My hands...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: That does not matter. Only our people are chosen as masters by golems with life within them. Golem, return to your master.
(At Minos's gesture, the magic golem Madori returns to Narsha's side.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Minos?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Memories from long ago returned to me, and for a moment I could not speak.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: %s, if you have brought this child here, something must have happened. Tell me about it.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: And you, child. What is your name?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: My name is... Narsha.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: One who will soar high... A fine meaning.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Forgive me, Narsha. Had I not been imprisoned here, you would surely have led a better life...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Your words alone mean a great deal. I'm all right. I've been doing well.
(Narsha smiles, but a hint of sadness shadows her face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is Narsha really all right?)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Narsha, tell me your story.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes. Well...
(Narsha tells Minos everything that happened in Orcarium, leaving nothing out.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: So there is another child who travels with a golem. If that child is in Orcarium...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You have an idea what it might mean.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Ordinary golems move when given magical power. Even those that now combine earth and machinery should be no different.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: When the Empire invaded, it took our golems to study and improve them. Yet there is something it has never managed to solve.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: A golem with a mind of its own... The kind that accompanies Narsha cannot simply be made at will.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It must hold an energy akin to that of spirits. Only we, who can sense that energy, can set it in motion.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So the Kali tribe and the people of Knossos are connected to spirits...)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Perhaps that explains it. The Empire's mages are digging through that place, and the child with the golem seems to be searching for something too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There must be something there.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: A power connected to spirits, right?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Indeed. Orcarium is a place of light that awakens spirits.
(Minos thinks for a moment, then drives his staff into the ground. Soon, Acro's Coffin and the rest of Knossos tremble slightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: You said there was no path to Orcarium, so I made one. Where people walk, a path shall be...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: %s, I have a request. Help this child and accompany her to Orcarium. The goddess has already asked you to aid her, after all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lord Minos. But what's that box behind you?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: This box? Ah, excellent timing.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Narsha, I have something for you. I found it in the ruined castle a few days ago.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Xerenis gave it to us long ago as a token of friendship. Pasiphae and I have no need of it now, so I will give it to you. Here, take it.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It is protective clothing infused with Xerenis's magic. It was made to suit a child who commands a golem.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Xerenis said it would suit the child Pasiphae and I might one day have, once they had grown...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: ...Are you sure you can give me something so precious?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lord Minos looks sad...)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Every object has an owner meant for it. This one seems to be yours.
(Narsha takes the box of clothes from Minos, at a loss for words.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thank you. I'll go change into it right away. I'd like to show you how it looks...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: ...You have a long journey ahead. Go now. Oh, you need not return here when your task is done... I will hear news of you from %s later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'll tell you. Then, Lord Minos, we'll be off to Orcarium.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: We'll be back, Lord Minos.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I never knew how welcome the words 'we'll be back' could sound...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wow...
(The instant we step forward, the scenery changes. The forest of Knossos is gone, replaced by a mysterious place where river and sea meet.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The path Lord Minos opened brought us straight to Orcarium Camp. From the El Anor Mountains to the western continent in an instant...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It really is amazing. It looks like we can go back too...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The clothes Lord Minos gave me are so light. They fit perfectly. And they're so pretty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They really suit you, Narsha. You have a whole new air about you. It's like you've awakened.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Awakened? That's good, right? I'm not sure what it means, but I'm happy you think they suit me. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh! Adventurer!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I think there's someone over by the camp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A mage carrying a huge book. Where have I seen him before?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: ...Someone from the Magic Bureau?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't be afraid. Follow me. I'll go first.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, adventurer.

steps.name: Help Me Understand
steps.objective: Defeat [Cheerful Moreni] and [Magic Number Zero] in 「Orcarium」, then turn in the quest to [Feta].

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Yaaawn... Sleepy. Hungry too...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I thought I'd be moving up once I returned to headquarters. Instead, another assignment away...
(Feta spots the two people approaching the camp and falls speechless in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: What? No one should be able to enter without the Magic Bureau's permission... Wait, those two...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: The adventurer is one thing, but they said the girl with the golem wasn't the culprit. What do they expect me to do on my own?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I'd better make something up and send them away. That adventurer will only bring a mountain of trouble...
(Having more or less composed himself, Feta greets them with a professional smile.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Welcome, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something about that smile bothers me...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while, Feta.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: It has. As for what happened in Gerda... Well. What brings you here? And that girl...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hello, mage. We've come on some business.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Hmm. Where did you come from? Every route here has been blocked.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Well, I'm sure you found your own way.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Under imperial law, anyone unaffiliated with the Magic Bureau is currently forbidden from passing through this area.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Please wait until the other Magic Bureau personnel arrive.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: And what if we won't?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I have orders to detain trespassers. Of course, as a mere mage, I could hardly face an adventurer whose abilities have made them a monster.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A monster?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: It's a figure of speech. Since you've come all this way, show me something that will convince me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Are you asking for money?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: No. Food. Eating is the only way I can replenish my magic...

lines.speaker: 냐르샤
lines.text: I have plenty of food.
(Narsha takes out a small pouch and reaches inside. She begins pulling out cakes and bread, one after another without stopping.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Jelic made this food-storage pouch using a method from his home village. As long as I supply a steady amount of magic, it maintains a constant temperature. Apparently, it can hold a houseful of bread.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Oh...? Fascinating. I don't know this Jelic, but I'd love to have that.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: No. It's mine. I'll give you lots of food, so don't get any ideas!

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I'm not especially fond of cake, but when you're hungry, you can't be picky.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Feta, eat later and help us first. You know what this is, don't you? Please help.
(When I produce my imperial identification card, Feta looks surprised.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Oh... I'm envious. An ordinary citizen could never obtain one of those...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: An identity guaranteed by the imperial family, with all sorts of extra privileges. How nice.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: From my position, there's neither a need nor a reason to stop the owner of that card... But if anything happens, I know nothing about it.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Just make sure I don't suffer for it.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's been a while since I've met someone so difficult.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Since you've given me cake to fill my stomach, I'll explain the situation here briefly.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Ah...
(Just as Feta is about to speak, a commotion rises from Orcarium outside the camp.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: The murderer is still rampaging around Orcarium, which is why it's so noisy outside.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: The animals are behaving strangely. Unfamiliar devils and demons have appeared, along with suspicious spirits and golems.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Would you help out for a moment while I eat? I'd deal with them myself, but I'm out of magic...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. All right. I'll keep them from reaching the camp. But you must explain things when I return.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, let's go together. I'll help too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait here a moment, Narsha. It might be dangerous. I'll be back quickly.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: All right. Oh, adventurer, just a moment...
(Narsha stands on tiptoe and whispers quietly.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: ...He might change his mind, so I'll keep feeding him. I've also picked up a map of the area. Go ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... All right. Keep him well fed.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I knew Narsha was capable, but I didn't know she worked like this too.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Then shall I go...?

steps.name: Exploring Orcarium
steps.objective: Defeat [Calm Alpharin] and [Archivist Dantalion] in 「Orcarium」, then turn in the quest to [Narsha].

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Cakes and bread from the Mongle Mongle Guild... I'd only heard about them. I never thought I'd get to eat them like this.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: ...You really are something. How can you eat so much? Without even offering a bite to the person in front of you.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: When mages focus on their magic, they tend to lose sight of their surroundings. That's how I am.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You certainly have an answer for everything.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Do I? Hehe... Oh, the adventurer is back.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Welcome back, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everything's been all right here?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Yes. Apart from me eating a little more than usual, nothing has happened at camp. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please tell us about the situation here, as you promised.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I don't have much information myself, so I'll keep it brief.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Since the murderer has no other name, I'll call him No Name, as my superiors do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No Name...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I'm sure you know this already, but No Name is the same kind of being as Narsha here...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: After causing the incident here, he went deeper into Orcarium and hasn't shown himself since.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: We have established that he moves around at regular intervals...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: How do you know that?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: ...The Magic Bureau has a sample of No Name's unique magical signature. I thought only Bureau mages had those registered, but his was there too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So it wasn't a coincidence that he attacked the Magic Bureau's mages.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: That's the work of our superiors. Low-ranking mages like me don't know much about it.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: If No Name's magic stops resonating with my instrument for long enough, we can assume he's more or less dead. Then all I need to do is inform headquarters...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: That's all I know. Even if I knew more, I couldn't disclose it for security reasons...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Then tell me what you know about No Name. You must know something too, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha and I came here to find things out. We don't have information about No Name.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: It doesn't have to be about No Name.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: You already associate with godlike beings, adventurer. It wouldn't make sense for you to know nothing.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Surely you know the Magic Bureau conducts all sorts of experiments?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Like placing food in a new vessel, we place new souls in bodies we've created. The miniature golems here are made that way. If we then use the life force of spirits...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: The explanation must sound complicated. These things are difficult for an ordinary person to understand...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait. What did I just hear? Is that really what the Magic Bureau does?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha?
(Narsha quietly tugs at %s's clothes.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Let's go...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, we should.
(Feta looks surprised as the adventurer and Narsha prepare to leave the camp.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Adventurer, you're leaving just like that? Do you really have nothing to tell me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Feta. We'll be going now.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Then it can't be helped. I've done you a favor, and you've helped me too...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Farewell. Still, come back to camp if you need help.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, thank you, mage.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Of course. Let's talk about golems sometime, if we get the chance.
(Once the two have left and the camp is quiet, Feta takes something from between the pages of the enormous spellbook he has been leaning against.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: No Name seems to be moving... Should I tell them? No, I'll follow them first.

steps.name: The Spirit's Voice
steps.objective: Talk to [Narsha] in 「Orcarium」 and look for [NoName]. Then return to [Narsha] and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I didn't expect the mage to follow us...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We've shaken him off, so we should be fine. I hope he goes back to camp.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha?
(Narsha looks around with her ears pricked up, seemingly concentrating on a distant sound.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I hear a strange sound.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Didn't you hear it, adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I didn't.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's going on? Is Narsha hearing something I can't?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, could you describe it?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I keep hearing voices chattering somewhere.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Madori seems to notice them too. He appears to be looking at the spirits along the path we came through...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Lord Minos said golems have an energy akin to that of spirits...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: He said Orcarium is a place of light that awakens spirits, didn't he?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Perhaps the voices I'm hearing belong to spirits.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, I'm curious about something. Can spirits and people understand each other?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That question caught me off guard. I've always been able to talk to them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zoe, who was with Iris, and Narin, who was with Lady Io in Gerda... I don't think I've had trouble talking with spirits who have lived among people for a long time.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hmm, I see...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Is it only spirits who've taken physical form before people...?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Huh? What's that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you hear another sound?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: No, it's not that...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I sense a power similar in nature to Madori's aura. Much stronger and more stable than his. Which means...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No Name...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, follow me. Let's proceed carefully.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes...
It's not here.
Why isn't it here? Why? Why?!
(In a quiet corner of Orcarium, a boy searches for something, the ears on top of his head twitching.)
I've searched over and over... It has to be here...
That sound... A spirit?
(The boy turns toward the strange sound.)
A golem?
I was mistaken.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Who were you talking to?
We met once, and now you're acting like we're friends...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That boy is No Name...)
I thought you'd run away. But you're back? Not scared at all? And you've brought a tacky human along.
(The elaborately dressed boy raises a hand and points at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha. That's the first time anyone's called me tacky... No Name.
(The boy lets out a faint laugh the instant he hears the name No Name.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: It isn't my name, but call me whatever you want. That's all I am, anyway. Something the Empire's humans don't think needs a name...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Sigh. Talking while looking at something so tacky is exhausting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's wrong with my clothes...?)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: How did you enter Orcarium? I blocked every passage here.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: The mage carrying that huge spellbook managed to get in somehow, but I left him alone since he wasn't in the way.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Ah... So you opened a path. You're with the Magic Bureau, just like that mage, aren't you?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: No? Fine, then. You've no business with me, have you? You'd better leave. I have no business with you either.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Isn't that better for both of us?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: There's something I want to ask you.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Why did you do it?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Do what?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Why did you... those people...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Do I have to say it?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: You already know part of it. What more do you want to know? A little girl like you couldn't handle it if I told you...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm the same as you...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I don't want to hear it. You've lived freely among humans. What could you possibly have to say?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Move... This has nothing to do with you.
(As No Name slowly walks past Narsha and the adventurer, a huge magic circle spreads beneath his feet.)
(His steps come to a halt.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: A magic circle made with the Magic Bureau's own spell formula. No, a magical trap.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be Feta...?
(Before the words are out, Feta appears behind Narsha and %s.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Thank you, adventurer. You've helped me capture No Name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Feta, wait. If you approach him like this...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Adventurer... No, outsider, stand back. This is Magic Bureau business. Even an identity recognized by the imperial family has no bearing on...
(As Feta addresses the adventurer, No Name laughs contemptuously and slowly walks toward him.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Wh-what's happening?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Did you think a magic circle of this caliber could restrain me? After I served as a guinea pig for every kind of curse and spell...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Damn it. Why am I even muttering about this...?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Licaria.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Kill them all...
(At No Name's words, a being that was nowhere to be seen a moment ago appears above his head. It rushes toward Feta.)
(Before anyone can react, metal crashes against metal. The massive impact raises a thick cloud of dust and shakes the space around us.)
(As the dust clears, No Name's enormous magic golem, the one Narsha described, comes into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the magic golem... Huh?
(The golden golem's arm, which had been about to strike Feta, appears to be held fast by something.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madori...?!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Mage, run!

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: What? Oh, right!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Where do you think you're going?
(At No Name's command, the golem shakes off Narsha's Madori and aims the Gatling gun mounted on its arm at Feta's fleeing back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop!
(The adventurer attacks the magic golem with their weapon. At Narsha's command, Madori acts as a shield, blocking the Gatling gun's bullets.)
(As Feta escapes, No Name's expression hardens. The golem stops moving and steps back in response.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Enough playing around. Keep getting in my way, and I'll kill you both.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That isn't going to happen.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What do you want so badly that you have to kill people?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: To pay them back for the pain I suffered.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: The mages? The council's nobles? Everyone connected to the Empire...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He's dangerous. I have to stop him... Is this why Iris asked me to look after Narsha?)
(As No Name continues speaking in anger, Narsha can bear no more and shouts.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Stop it!!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: You've grown up comfortably among humans... You even have a name. Narsha...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Why do you think you have that golem? Do you know why the Magic Bureau's humans called you 'back' there?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What would have happened if you hadn't been suited to that golem, Madori or whatever? You'd be like me... Hehehe...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What he's saying... Narsha?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I had a feeling...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: There's your answer. Stay out of my way.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Even so, that doesn't give you a reason to kill everyone.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: ...I've heard your answer. Then here...
(No Name's ears prick up, and he looks off somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: So you've finally appeared? I can feel it... You've been hiding, quietly watching what happened.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: So you don't care how it turns out...?
(Still muttering cryptically, No Name climbs onto his magic golem.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Licaria. What we're looking for is over there. Let's go...
(As though entranced, No Name boards the magic golem he calls Licaria.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No Name!!
(Ignoring %s's cry, the magic golem Licaria rises into the sky and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: W-we're too late.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is he going?
(As Narsha watches the sky with the adventurer, her ears twitch.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I hear a loud sound. Over there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the way we came. Um, Narsha...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes? Oh, I'm all right...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Just a little frustrated. Heh.
(Narsha smiles lightly and stretches.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We still don't know what No Name is looking for, but let's find it first. Then we'll know what it is.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes!

steps.name: What NoName Wants
steps.objective: Defeat [Magic Golem Ricaria] in 「Enteleche of Life」, then return to [Narsha] and turn in the quest.

lines.text: (Back at the place where we briefly stopped before meeting No Name, Narsha's ears grow even busier.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ugh...
(Narsha's expression keeps changing, perhaps because of something %s cannot hear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Is it very loud?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It isn't loud. I can't quite describe it...
(Narsha raises her head and looks around.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Sounds are coming from several directions, but over there... I think they're calling me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They're calling you?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Um, adventurer.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Could we go that way first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, it's dangerous over there.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's just as dangerous here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't leave Narsha alone, and I can't tell her to stay at the camp...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's go together.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I promise I won't be a burden. I have Madori too.
(The magic golem Madori on Narsha's shoulder rocks its body as though acknowledging her words.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madori seems more active than before.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Doesn't he? Hmm... Since I put on the clothes Lord Minos gave me, I can definitely sense Madori's feelings more clearly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall we go, then?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes! I'll lead the way.
(Narsha goes ahead. Just as the adventurer is about to follow, an unfamiliar feeling approaches.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This ominous feeling... It's like when I saw the record...)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Stay calm. Otherwise, I won't be able to find No Name...)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: There's a door here. But there's a cliff right in front of it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The door has something like spirit wings attached to it. I can definitely feel magic from inside.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Why are you calling me? I... I...
(Narsha reaches out, and the door trembles. A moment later, a fierce wind pours out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The wind is too strong to withstand...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Narsha?
(As the wind eases and I look ahead, an unbelievable sight unfolds. The wind from the door has lifted Narsha into the air and surrounds her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Take my hand...
(The adventurer hurriedly reaches for Narsha, but the wind seizes them both and sends them flying into the world beyond the door.)
Thud!
(In the blink of an eye, the wind disappears, dropping the adventurer from the air to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uuugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The wind suddenly blew us here... Huh? Narsha?
(I come to my senses and look around, but Narsha is nowhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha? Narsha... is gone. Where is she? For that matter, where am I?
(The world beyond the door is utterly different from the brightly lit Orcarium of moments before.)
(Columns stretching downward from above lie broken, and strange walls of an ominous color stand upon the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A cave? No, that isn't it. This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Reverse Side...

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: I never wanted to see it again... Yet this place has opened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-who's there?
(I look around at the sudden voice. A young man with blond hair and shining eyes slowly appears.)
A place no one could see unless a god opened it has opened again. Perhaps... No, I was mistaken... I'd hoped...
(Cold, sharp wings emerge from the young man's back. Orbs of light rise around him, illuminating the surroundings.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A spirit...?
I should pay my respects to one blessed by an ancient god, but I have no desire to. You've even brought an unwelcome guest...
I am El-Larsa, follower of Orca.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa? Ah, I've heard your voice in the El Anor Mountains.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: So that voice still remains.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You seem to know this place well. Would you help me? I need to find someone.
(El-Larsa's expression hardens. The orbs circling him become long, enormous spears. At a gesture, one flies past %s's side.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what...?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I have no desire to take such orders from you. Though I have no reason to kill a human...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Instead, I will make you one promise.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Go back. I will not harm one who is merely a tool of the gods.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: If you break this agreement, things will be different. Lord Orca has permitted it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't leave. I have to find Narsha...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Is that the hybrid born of a witch's tainted aura mixed with the power of spirits?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Forcing open the sealed Enteleche of Life and trespassing within... I will not let this stand...
(As El-Larsa finishes, the orbs around him turn into bursts of blinding light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, it's blinding.
(As the flashes subside, the place El-Larsa called the 'Enteleche of Life' comes back into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa is gone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He sees Narsha as a 'hybrid'...? She can't be what that spirit described... Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No Name... Is No Name here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha is in danger. I have to find her quickly.
(As I wander the Enteleche of Life, a deafening noise fills the space.)
Rrrrumble... KRAAASH!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, the ground is shaking.
KRRRAAASH!!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: The spirits keep saying it's here. Why isn't it?! I even cleared out all the devils in my way. Why isn't it here?!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Licaria, destroy everything!!
KRAAASH!!
(At No Name's command, the magic golem Licaria smashes the columns and walls before it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No Name!!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: How did you get in? Without a spirit's power, this place...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Ah, that little girl...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As long as you're here, both you and Narsha are in danger. We have to leave.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: ...I can't leave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The spirit guarding this place might kill you both.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: If he wants to kill me, he must see me as a hybrid. Tch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He knows El-Larsa called him a hybrid...)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: You heard it too? That spirit calling me a hybrid... Can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Hehehe... Hehehe...
(No Name's eyes suddenly turn cold.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: ...Stay out of my way, human.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha won't be safe until you leave.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: You're irritating...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: You and that little girl... Humans who can live alongside everyone else...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No Name, get a hold of yourself...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Enough. I won't listen to you. I... I!! I...!!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I'm just looking for what I need!!
Thud!
(With a thunderous crash, the enormous magic golem Licaria lands in front of the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Licaria...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Tear that human apart...
(The magic golem Licaria's movements slow, and pieces that look like components fall to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah... Hah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I've fought golems before, but Licaria is on another level. I can't fall here...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But where is Narsha?)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Why won't you give up? Licaria, one final attack...
(No Name looks in alarm at the staggering magic golem Licaria.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The golem is moving strangely...)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Licaria...?
KRRRAAASH!!
(The moment No Name approaches to examine Licaria, the golem releases a huge explosion, sending him and the adventurer flying.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... What was that explosion?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Gah... Why did Licaria...?
(When the adventurer and No Name recover and look at Licaria, a column from above and the wall behind have already collapsed onto it.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Licaria?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be... To save No Name...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Considering how Madori tried to save Narsha, Licaria must have done the same.)
(Then the magic golem Licaria slowly rises from the fallen rubble.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Let's stop here for today. My efforts have just come to nothing.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Narsha!!!!!!!
(At No Name's cry, Licaria rises into the air and throws the axe it holds toward a distant wall.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No Name!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?
(The axe, seemingly about to strike the wall, slowly floats upward. A moment later, the beings holding it become visible.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: So I have to watch the sleeping golems and spirit eggs awaken because of that little girl...
