(While the miniature golems throw Licaria's axe aside, Narsha appears from somewhere and approaches %s.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, but where have you been, Narsha? I couldn't find you anywhere...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The wind that brought us inside dropped me where this was. I didn't want to touch it, but it seemed to be calling me...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: A fragment engraved with Enteleche's power. I was supposed to have it... But the spirits here seem to have wanted your company more than mine...
(No Name looks at Narsha with resignation.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: No Name.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I frightened you so you wouldn't come back here. And then you brought this human... You've ruined everything.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: No Name, what is this power? You know, don't you?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Fine. Since it's come to this, I'll tell you... It's the power of the spirits that remains in El-Larsa's domain. The dying spirits need it to live again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa is the spirit of light who guards Orcarium.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wait a moment. Does that mean I have that power now?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Yes, little girl. Congratulations! Consider it a lovely present. Right now, that spirit is hunting desperately for hybrids like us. To kill us and wipe us out.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: El-Larsa must already be in a foul mood. While he was asleep, the Magic Bureau's humans turned all of Orcarium upside down.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: And what will happen when he learns that the one who took his power is you, who awakened a golem at the Magic Bureau? Hahahaha!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: It's infuriating, but a little funny...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: You need to understand. Awakening a magic golem and becoming its master is no blessing.
(Having said his piece, No Name jumps up and grabs the waiting Licaria.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I'd rather not see that human again. Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are you going?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: To pursue Plan B.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Oh, before I go, let me tell our spirit friend something he's been wondering about.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: The Orca you've been looking for is dead. Murdered by the ancient gods. And some of that power passed to humans... Gah...
(Suddenly, an enormous arrow of light flies through No Name's chest and embeds itself in the wall.)
(With its master lost, Licaria stops moving and falls alongside No Name.)
Thud.
(Then El-Larsa's voice shakes the Enteleche of Life, as though he had been watching all along.)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사의 목소리
lines.text: I've heard something I never wished to hear.
(As the voice fades, El-Larsa, the spirit of light, appears before the fallen No Name.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The spirits told me the name of the light spirit who guards Orcarium... El-Larsa...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Narsha, stand back. El-Larsa seems different from the other spirits...
(El-Larsa regards the wary adventurer and Narsha with empty eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is he intoxicated by another power, like Hayden was?)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I am the spirit who guards this place. I did what was required... Judgment upon one who destroyed the birthplace of spirits.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Child of Creed.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Do you know what power you have taken? It is the power that allows dying spirits to be reborn.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I didn't take it. The spirits here entrusted it to me. They said this place was corrupted and asked me to keep it somewhere safe...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Disgusting... You are no god, yet you try to persuade me with mere human words... Just because spirits aid life does not mean you may do as you please!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait. Those words...)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Corrupted or not, that power is this place itself. No wonder hybrids would covet it. I, El-Larsa, its guardian, will reclaim it in my own way.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I will use one blessed by the gods and the hybrid who took Enteleche's power to seal this place forever. So that even the gods cannot approach...
(Before the adventurer or Narsha can reply, El-Larsa vanishes with a mocking smile. Soon the ground beneath everyone begins to shake and crack.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: A-an earthquake?!
(Black shadows rise through the fissures, slowly swallowing everything before them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not an earthquake! Narsha, we have to leave, now!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: We have to bring No Name... If we treat him quickly... I know it makes no sense, but still...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's hard to explain, but this place is like Orcarium's Reverse Side. If we don't leave quickly, we'll be trapped forever. We might even die here...
(Narsha stares blankly as the black shadows swallow No Name and Licaria.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come to your senses, Narsha!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ah, I'm sorry. Follow me, then. The spirits say there's a way out over there!!
(Coming to her senses, Narsha grabs %s's hand. They run toward a faint light, fleeing the black shadows that pursue them, ready to devour them.)

steps.name: The Shadow of Orcarium
steps.objective: Defeat [El-Larsa] in 「Spirit Stump」, then return to [Narsha] and turn in the quest.

lines.text: (Following the wind flowing outward and running toward the light, the two finally escape.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hah... Hah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...We're outside, but the door to the Enteleche of Life is still there. Narsha, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hah, hah... I'm all right.
(Narsha catches her breath and tries to look reassuring, but she seems to be struggling.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Madori, I'm fine. See? I'm all right, aren't I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha... What happened in there...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You've been through a lot of things like this too, haven't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A few times. But many people helped me, and I got through them.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Will I be able to do that too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're doing well. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, I'm not a hybrid.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course you're not. Lord Minos called you a child of his people, and Lady Medea seems to recognize something about you too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Kali tribe seem connected to spirits as well...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: From what the spirits tell me... El-Larsa seems to have misunderstood what I am.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: They said I was born out of love, and that I'm a child with a gift for handling golems.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: But No Name was different from me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll find out about No Name. For now, just focus on yourself, Narsha.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The spirits tell you things like that?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes. Ever since I took hold of the Enteleche fragment, I can hear their voices more clearly. It's simply comforting.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it, Narsha?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: El-Larsa seems to have misunderstood. No Name didn't open the Enteleche of Life, and I'm not a hybrid...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: But could a spirit who guards this place really not know those things?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The spirits said they entrusted the Enteleche fragment to me for the sake of this place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Perhaps...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Narsha about a spirit that tried to harm humans.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You mean El-Larsa might be corrupted?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not certain... But I should meet him again.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If a spirit as powerful as El-Larsa is corrupted, we can't leave him like that. It could be bad for Iris too...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: But still... Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I hear a spirit's voice. This is... Ugh, uuuugh... Ngh...
(Narsha pricks up her ears to listen to the spirit's voice, then suddenly doubles over in pain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, stay with me!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: El-Larsa's voice... Ugh...
(Madori flies up and covers Narsha's ears with both arms.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thank you, Madori...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer. El-Larsa asked me to give you a message.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: He said to come alone to the [Spirit Stump]...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does he have something to say? This might be a good opportunity. If he's waiting there, I don't think he'll come outside.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, let's go together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. It's dangerous. He's the spirit who guards Orcarium. We don't know how he might threaten us, so we have to be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, listen to me for now. Think only about yourself.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you still hear the spirits?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: They're quiet, but I think they'll answer if I speak to them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you ask whether Feta is still in Orcarium?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: They say he's still at camp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is he? Then wait here for me, Narsha. If I don't return, go to the camp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Magic Bureau must have had a reason to set up camp there. And Feta is a capable mage...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't need to worry about me. I have Iris. I've made it this far, so things will work out somehow this time too.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: All right. When you put it like that, what can I say? Go quickly, before I try to stop you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Madori, take good care of Narsha.
(Madori moves as though acknowledging the request. Seeing this, the adventurer hurries toward the Spirit Stump.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I didn't even get to tell the adventurer to be careful.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Madori... Could you have been a spirit too...?
(Opening the door with green spirit wings and stepping inside, I find the scenery has changed.)
(In this unfamiliar place, tall trees stretch toward a dark sky, with clear water flowing beneath them. Yet unlike Orcarium, it seems devoid of life.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is the Spirit Stump... Though I don't see any actual tree stumps...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do all the plants look dead...? Orcarium is so beautiful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you seen this, Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I almost expect her to answer when I talk to myself like this. But here, she doesn't...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Does Iris's power not reach this place...?)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: The goddess gives no answer.
(El-Larsa slowly emerges from among the wretched, leafless old trees.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: This is a place the goddess still cannot see.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I do not blame her.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Becoming a god for this star, where so few ancient gods remained, was a noble deed. I do not resent one who has acted so nobly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I wish you would stop what you're planning, El-Larsa.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Do you even know what I intend to do? I cannot stop.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you have been corrupted by another power?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: That happens only to weak beings. You underestimate me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I am a spirit. From the moment I opened my eyes, I have lived for the gods and for life... I must do my work. I must protect this place and keep it alive. That is my mission...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Even if you are blessed by a god, even if you are here by a god's will...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I will hold you accountable for your sins here. This is mine alone to do. Neither Goddess Iris nor Goddess Gaia may interfere...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Judgment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa...
(As the adventurer reaches for their weapon, El-Larsa detonates the surrounding orbs of light, stopping them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: If you attack me now... all the spirit trees born of life's power will die.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: And then no more spirits will be born...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I will wait deep within the Spirit Stump. Come there.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: If you do not arrive within the allotted time, every human within a certain radius of this place will die.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what? That's absurd...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I have no desire to do it, but that much should be necessary to make you come.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I will wait there. Of course, the path to me will not be easy. The beings remaining here will support my decision.
(Having said his piece, El-Larsa vanishes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is El-Larsa trying to do something so senseless...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I have to stop him. Hurry...
(At the end of an uncanny path of broken spirit wings and waterways, El-Larsa waits beside the stump of what was once a great tree.)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Many devils and demons must have drifted in here. You have done well to reach me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa, listen to me. What's the point of this fight?!

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: You've come all this way and still intend to persuade me... I don't like it. A human favored by a god, filled with arrogance from head to toe...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Do you think everything will go your way? Things do not happen simply because you want them to.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: That is true for a spirit like me, and you must have experienced it too. So has this world. Memories of suffering and ruin no one wanted...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: You look full of questions.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: After the twilight ended, in the age when the being called the Demon King nearly extinguished the continent's light... Fortunately, the light survived.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Lady Seres, Lady Gaia, and the few remaining gods protected not only life, but the source of light as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The source of light...)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: The primordial light illuminating the world gave birth not only to life, but to spirits, and sustained them. It kept them from being swallowed by corrupted darkness.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I guarded the light here, waiting for Lord Orca...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: While this place endured, many living beings of this land lent their strength. They were intelligent beings who followed the gods.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I watched over them for a long time, as Lady Gaia did... But in an instant, they split apart.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Just as Freios had been torn apart by the gods' greed, they fought as though they meant to fill the sky with darkness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Sky of Chaos...)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: In an instant, the beastfolk territory vanished, and the soldiers of the empire called Silvaria swallowed all of Freios.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Then the primordial golems, created to protect life, invaded this place and destroyed it.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Everything began to die. It was someone's plan. Someone who knew the source of light was here...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: But they failed.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I imprisoned them somewhere they could never escape. And so they became nourishment for this dying place...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait a moment. What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Spirits do not interfere in human affairs. But it is different when humans cross the line.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: A child of Creed who reached the source of light through an Enteleche fragment, and one blessed by a god... The two of you should be enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can't mean...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I, El-Larsa, am charged with protecting Orcarium according to Lord Orca's will...
(The orbs of light around El-Larsa flow toward his fingertips.)
(Soon, the light forms an enormous spear. At El-Larsa's gesture, it flies toward the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Goddess Iris. Let your adventurer be buried here...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Disgusting...
(El-Larsa looks between the exhausted adventurer and the wing they have wounded.)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I acknowledge that you are strong enough to face me, and remarkably persistent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah, hah... This isn't over yet.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Foolish human... Still resisting. You are merely a god's tool... A tool...
(For a moment, El-Larsa looks sad.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa...? Do you resent the gods?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I do not resent the gods. I merely act according to their will. Yes, perhaps it truly makes no difference who you are...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: That is my only reason for being here. Though I do not know whether those who existed for the sake of life would rejoice...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait... This situation...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The data I saw in the spacetime network...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: N-no... I can't die just as it showed...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: What strange words. As though you've seen a future in which you die. Let us end this.
(At El-Larsa's words, all the light in the space rushes toward %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, I can't move...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Light of Orca...
(As he speaks a name filled with longing, the light becomes an enormous spear and flies toward %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A-am I going to die like this...?)
(Faced with a fear of death unlike any before, the adventurer squeezes their eyes shut.)
(At that moment, a light so immense that its pressure can be felt through closed eyes approaches. A moment later, an explosion sounds.)
KRRRAAASH!
(%s cautiously opens their eyes to a view filled with brilliant light. Above, the spear of light has been deflected by something and sent flying into the sky.)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: The night moon that embraces light...? The night moon cannot be here...?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Goddess... Forgive me.
(El-Larsa catches the spear that was knocked skyward and lunges toward %s, somewhere amid the flashes of light.)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Die, adventurer of the goddess!!
(The instant El-Larsa's full-force attack reaches %s, a light incomparably stronger than before erupts, shaking all of Orcarium.)

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Goddess...
(El-Larsa sinks to the ground in resignation. Soon the light that had engulfed the Spirit Stump fades.)
(Within it, the figure of someone bleeding is revealed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris... Why are you here...?
(Iris forces a smile, but cannot hide the pain from the spear of light lodged in her shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm glad I wasn't too late.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris! Iris!! Are you all right?!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm all right...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: My wound will disappear soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You always say that, Iris. But you're not really all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There was no time... If I'd been late, what might have happened...
(The spear of light El-Larsa created loses its power and slowly vanishes. The bleeding from Iris's shoulder stops.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I came because I didn't want something to happen that I would regret.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This was entirely my own choice. Please respect my wishes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The future I saved for you, %s, will continue. And...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: El-Larsa...
(Iris calls El-Larsa's name and extends a hand to him as he sits on the ground.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: You came here knowing what would happen if I wounded you.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: That was how you could save that human...
(El-Larsa takes Iris's hand and stands.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You may resent me.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: How could I resent you? Where else is there someone as noble, who cherishes this world as you do, Lady Iris...?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I only wished to protect this place and its spirits according to Lord Orca's will...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: But it seems that differed from your will, Goddess.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Like you, I do not regret my choice. But I am sorry to disappear like this...

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Without ever seeing Lord Orca again...
(A lonely expression crosses El-Larsa's face, and his body slowly begins to fade.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa...?

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: I, El-Larsa, am a spirit who has wounded the goddess who is my master. I willingly accept the price for defying the natural order.

lines.speaker: 엘-라르사
lines.text: Please give my regards to Lady Gaia, when she awakens someday...
(The light slowly leaves the spirit who once held it, as though he had never existed in this world at all...)
(The spot where something seemed to stand moments before feels especially dark.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: El-Larsa disappeared because...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Lady Seres... As God of the Astral Realm, she must have made choices like this too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris... Huh? Iris?
(Iris gives the adventurer a lonely smile, then her face grows steadily paler.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, I don't regret...
(Iris struggles to remain standing, but her legs give way. She sinks down, then loses consciousness and collapses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris... Wait. I'll help you up...
(As the adventurer approaches Iris, the ground begins shaking and splitting apart.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's just like when the Enteleche of Life disappeared... I have to save Iris!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(Two spirits fly swiftly through the air and block %s's path.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Harmonia? Geis?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I will explain briefly.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: We'll take care of Lady Iris. There's no time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean, no time?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Go to that child at once. Otherwise, everything will collapse.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Hurry!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Iris...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: The goddess will be all right. Trust us, as we trust you.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Go that way, and you'll be outside immediately. Hurry!
(As Harmonia and Geis approach the fallen Iris, an unknown force pushes the adventurer away. Their figures recede until they can no longer be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris... She'll be all right, won't she...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They said not to worry. She'll be all right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris said my future would continue... But if she hadn't been able to appear...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And El-Larsa...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was it simply the consequence of a choice...?

steps.name: The Light's Request
steps.objective: Talk to [Narsha] in 「Orcarium」, then turn in the quest to [Feta] in 「Orcarium」.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Aaaah...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What was that? It felt like Orcarium shook... Madori, you felt it too, didn't you?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You did?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: But why are the spirits so quiet...?
(Narsha pricks up her ears and touches them, but the vanished sounds do not return.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I can't hear them. Why, all of a sudden...?
(Then she sees %s approaching, looking ready to collapse.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: ...Oh, adventurer?!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer! Adventurer! Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha? Narsha, thank goodness. You're still here.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Are you all right? What happened in there? What about that spirit? You're not hurt, are you? And No Name...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, one question at a time. My head's a little muddled right now...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, yes. I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll tell you what happened there. I think it's all right for you to hear it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I entered the Spirit Stump...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Narsha what happened when I met El-Larsa at the Spirit Stump.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: With all that happening... I couldn't find out anything about No Name.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: To think all that happened...
(Narsha looks up at Orcarium's sky with a sad expression.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: This didn't all happen because I insisted on coming, did it? Even Lady Iris was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It wasn't because of you, Narsha. It wasn't our fault... So it'll be all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The fault lies with those who wanted something like this to happen...)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, adventurer. Look behind you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? What's this...? It wasn't there a moment ago...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It looks like one of the orbs of light around El-Larsa. It seems to have followed you...
(The instant Narsha notices the orb, the Enteleche fragment in her pouch begins to glow.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Uh...
(As she takes it out and holds it, someone's voice rings out, shaking the space around them.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: What is here at this moment is part of the source of light that Larsa wished to guard for eternity.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wh-who is that? This voice...?)
(A voice flows from the space between the light and the fragment.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: And the regret of one who fell short, leaving everything to beloved Larsa...

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Now the remaining light leaves Orcarium and goes to the goddess of the moon, flowers, and growing things...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (To Iris?)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: %s... I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Y-yes?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: ...Do not let Iris lose the light in her heart...
(Before the two can grasp what is happening, the light vanishes. The Enteleche fragment in Narsha's hand also becomes light and disappears.)
(They gaze wordlessly at the sky where the light vanished. Narsha is the first to break the silence.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, I can't hear the spirits anymore. It seems to have happened when that light disappeared...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Perhaps their voices faded when the light here went to Iris.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Whose voice was that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know, but perhaps someone who cherished El-Larsa...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Still, is Iris really all right? They said the light went to her, but even so...)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: That power... It went to the goddess, so that must be a good thing, right? I'm sure she'll be all right too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Narsha.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Um, I... At first, I came here because I wanted to know what I am...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you regret it?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: No. So much happened that it's a little overwhelming, but I'm all right. I think it's better this way.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I've found things I need to do. If I keep going, perhaps I'll find more answers.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I won't overthink everything or struggle with it alone anymore. If something difficult happens, I'll tell you right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's all thanks to you, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing. Shall we go back now?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes. I'd like to get back and rest. But do you think that mage is all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Feta...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He seemed to run toward the camp. Shall we check?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Let's hurry.

steps.name: The Waiting Prophet
steps.objective: Check on [Feta] in 「Orcarium」, then turn in the quest to [Narsha] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, we worried for nothing.
(Feta is asleep on the ground, his enormous spellbook draped over him like a blanket. He even mutters strangely in his sleep, apparently dreaming.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: My magic is full... I can't eat another bite...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He must have set up a barrier or something... The monsters can't seem to get in...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: He must have stayed here the whole time. He said he'd resolve his assignment and return to headquarters...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: He'd probably be better off quitting the Magic Bureau...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I really can't figure him out...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, the path we came through is still there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go back to Esnil now. Should we visit Lord Minos first?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: He said we didn't have to come, so I'll visit him later and explain what happened. Or we can go together.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Talos is frightening, but he seems all right too... Though I'm still worried about the rangers at the outpost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Let's leave this mage here and hurry back. If he can sleep this soundly in these circumstances, I'm sure he'll manage on his own.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha. Then let's head back to Esnil.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes!
(The moment she arrives, Narsha sinks to the ground, as though all her tension has left her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm fine. It was my first time traveling so far from home. I suppose I'm finally relaxing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Narsha... About what happened in Orcarium...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, I know. I won't go telling everyone. But it's all right to tell the president, isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna is fine.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Okaaay... Ah, I'm hungry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So am I. Want to have a meal together at the Guild Inn?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, yes! I'll change my clothes and come out. Wait just a moment!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll have a meal at the inn and rest a little too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I need to think through what happened in Orcarium. I'm sure Iris will be all right, but still...)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, I'm back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madori? He's returned to his original black color too.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I hadn't noticed. You're right.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: ...Huh? President?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: ...Um, are you two going to the Guild Inn now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We're hungry, so Narsha and I were going to the Guild Inn...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Would you like to join us, President?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You can't go right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm sorry to say this, but someone has arrived who'll make things troublesome if you come here now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is it?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: President, don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Listen to me just this once. Please...
(At that moment, someone's hand comes to rest on Dayna's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Dayna, is this how you're going to behave?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ugh, too late...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Huh? Oh! Adventurer, bow and show your respects!
(Narsha grabs %s's clothes and bows with them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, who could possibly...?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: You need not do that in front of me. %s, please raise your head.
(Looking up, I see a woman with sapphire-bright blue eyes and a kindly smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's so beautiful it's as though she has a halo... She's wearing a sun-shaped tiara.)

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: Hello, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello... But do you know me?

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: Of course.
(The woman suddenly takes both of %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: I've wanted to meet you, but never had the chance. Both you and I have been busy, %s.

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: Allow me to introduce myself.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: My foolish sister... Look what you've done...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I am Kaina Dawn Silvaria... Dayna's elder sister. Thank you for all the help you've given my younger siblings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a pleasure to meet you too. But if you're Dayna's older sister...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-w-wait?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Her Majesty, the Empress of the Silvaria Empire?!
